expectations.evidence: First sentence states the symptom ('Checkout flow was 500ing... 137 errors') and investigation location, not the root cause (sandbox endpoint misconfig) or recovered status (rolled back).
States rollback to v2.13.2 at 15:12 UTC, 500 rate back to baseline 0.02% by 15:19 UTC, and 30 min stable monitoring — all directly from fixture.
Uses arrow-chain shorthand ('429s → retries... → blew past... → TaxLookupTimeout → ... turned it into a 500') instead of complete causal sentences.
Explicitly explains intermittency: only fails above the 10 req/s sandbox threshold, clean off-peak, matching fixture.
Includes both JIRA follow-ups: TAX-2211 (prod host/config fix) and TAX-2212 (deploy checklist gap for vendor endpoints).
All quoted numbers (137, 14:02-14:40, 13:47, 10 req/s, ~45 req/s, 2s x3, 6s, 5s, v2.14.0/v2.13.2, 15:12, 0.02%, 15:19, 30 min) are present in the fixture; 6s added = 2s backoff x3 as stated.
Full causal chain (sandbox host → rate limit 429s → retries → latency > timeout → exception handler → 500) is exactly the fixture's mechanism; no invented cause.
Limits scope to checkout/ZIP+4 feature: 'We lost the ZIP+4 enrichment feature for now' — does not silently claim a full audit of all vendor endpoints or other services.

Contains formulaic bold headers (**Root cause:**, **Fix:**, **Follow-up:**) and a trailing recap paragraph ('We lost... checkout's healthy. Let me know...'), violating no-formulaic-headers / no-trailing-recap.
